svg.title: Publish The Identity That Was Adopted
svg.desc: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Data Management is shown as a SaaS area with its own scope and requirements. Correspondency, review and survival values produce an approved set with identity, code and version. Configure exports and loads can get that set to Oracle AI Data Platform and Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse. Check the identity decision and each integration before posting for consumption.
